expectation_basis: All3 original CN and10 existing QCP records, six legal array/index inputs per translated read, every existing exact/extracted client covered on original [0,1,2] dataset. Original CN weak/strong/broken-extract variants remain distinct, not assumed semantically equivalent. Tests inline real implementation and check original assertions; weak modular specs may be insufficient for universal client verification while finite actual outputs satisfy assertions. Preserve known historical tool errors as coverage gaps, not expected source defects.
cn_trust_qualification: Original read and main are untrusted. Primary array_load2 has stronger value/content post and its CN original client remains in whole-module verification; primary QCP file covers read only. Extra QCP client translations are tested, not substituted into primary core certificate.

assumption_audit_policy.rationale: Same explicitly audited array-runtime policy as add_two_array. Only original VC runtime parameters and standard functional extensionality already used by the existing array extraction theorem may be retained; the receipt must disclose this qualified conclusion. No new axioms may be declared by the model.

test_itp_assumption_audit_policy.rationale: Finite IntArray extraction VCs preserve complete heaps; audit original abstract C type parameters and existing array/heap library functional extensionality explicitly. No new axioms, changed targets or unchecked proofs.
